operators.name: custom_softmax

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [B, C, L] with C=16, L=16384 in this task

semantics: Computes softmax over dimension dim (default 1) for each slice of x.
For each index i along dim, output[..., i, ...] = exp(x[..., i, ...] - max) / sum_j exp(x[..., j, ...] - max), where max is the max over dim for numerical stability.
The operation is elementwise across other dimensions, preserving shape and stride.
No reduction over batch or channel/sequence dimensions beyond dim.
Input must be CUDA float32 tensor; output is new tensor with same shape, dtype, device.

operators.name: custom_cumprod

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: [B, C, L] with C=16, L=16384 in this task

semantics: Computes cumulative product along dimension dim (default 2).
For index i along dim, output[..., i, ...] = product_{k=0}^{i} x[..., k, ...].
The operation is elementwise across other dimensions, preserving shape and stride.
Input must be CUDA float32 tensor; output is new tensor with same shape, dtype, device.
Compute softmax along dimension 1 (channels) for input x of shape [512,16,16384].
Result has same shape, dtype float32, on CUDA.
Numerically stable softmax using max subtraction and exp sum.
Compute cumulative product along dimension 2 (sequence length) of the softmax output.
Result has same shape, dtype float32, on CUDA.
Cumulative product: output[..., i] = prod_{k=0}^{i} input[..., k].
The final tensor after cumprod, shape [512,16,16384], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
Returned directly as the model output.
